data.body: Live parity: fixed REST search and CI-pinned ACLI --limit 1000 return identical ordered keys. All non-URL leaf fields match across 1000 tickets. Differences are only Jira gateway vs tenant URL forms in issuetype/priority/status self/iconUrl, statusCategory.self and assignee.self. Running existing inbound_fields._map_jira_to_local_fields on both payloads yields 0 canonical-field mismatches across all 1000. make verify running; lint, typecheck (772 source files) and import guard passed. No payload normalization or timeout configuration change introduced.
